issue_request: FHIR-39510 was a Published/Persuasive R5 Orders and Observations change request to add DeviceDispense to the SupplyRequest Boundaries and Relationships text alongside MedicationDispense and BiologicallyDerivedProductDispense.
initial_application: Jira records that John Nolen added the change to the build in commit a198b29aae2ef6981542b3c57f0f1be0a203a16c, which inserted the requested paragraph into source/supplyrequest/supplyrequest-introduction.xml.
additional_context: The 2022-11-21 OO HCP minutes approved this SupplyRequest boundary update as part of a four-Jira SupplyRequest motion. Later core history removed SupplyRequest and related immature OO resources from active fhir.ini build lists and redirected core pages to the OO Incubator IG; a 2025 OO Zulip thread confirms the resources were pulled from core to progress together externally.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. The current active FHIR core build does not own SupplyRequest, the retained local source already contains the requested text, and the current HL7/oo-incubator SupplyRequest page-content source also contains the requested boundary paragraph.
